how-to-deposit-skins-via-peerpay.title: How to deposit skins via WaxPeer Pay

content.p1: When you first visit the site, you will most likely see this screen and won't be able to sell. You will need to provide your Trade link and save it.
content.p2: Once everything is set up and you are ready to sell, your page will look like this:
content.p3: After clicking on an item, it will move to the adjacent window. From there, you can complete the sale by clicking the button.
